title: How to build an integrated crypto research process
objective: Combine tokenomics, protocol economics, liquidity, risk and scenarios into a sourced research report that states its unknowns.

title: How blockchains and digital assets work
objective: Explain what a blockchain records, how blocks link, how keys control funds, and why venue prices differ from reference prices.

title: A company-analysis workflow
objective: Follow profit, cash and the balance sheet of a company as one consistent story, and turn ratios into questions.

title: Building a research view you can defend
objective: Combine evidence, a valuation range, risks and a monitoring plan into one research view, and state what would prove it wrong.

title: How the Indian share market works
objective: Explain what a share is, how a trade settles in India, and why a share price and the business behind it are different things.

title: How to analyse blockchain data quantitatively
objective: Treat chain and market data as measurements with definitions, clean and align them, and recognise the biases that inflate results.

title: Testing ideas without fooling yourself
objective: Describe what a fair historical test needs, and recognise look-ahead bias, survivorship bias, overfitting and multiple testing.

title: How token supply and incentives affect analysis
objective: Distinguish circulating, total and maximum supply, and show how unlocks, emissions and burns change circulating supply.
